title: learn-from-pr learner profile
description: A learner profile, or a partial one. The built-in default is complete. A user override and a per-report override list only the fields they change.

name.description: A short label for the profile. The skill shows it in the profile notice.

writing_style.description: asd-ste100 applies the ASD-STE100-inspired rules in SKILL.md. plain applies no extra rules.

format_priority.description: Format order for each piece of information. Use the first format that fits. Prose is last.

target_read_minutes.description: Target reading time for the prose in the document. The skill allows 150 words for each minute.

max_words_per_section.description: Hard limit for the prose in one section.

sections.description: Ordered list of the sections to write. A section that is not in the list is off.

diagram_type.description: Kind of diagram in the architecture section.

neighbor_depth.description: Number of hops from a touched component to include. 0 shows only touched components.

max_nodes.description: Largest number of nodes in the diagram. The skill groups unchanged neighbors first when it must cut nodes.

show_change_size.description: Show files changed and lines added and removed on each touched node.

map_changes_to_components.description: Assign every changed file and hunk to a diagram component, and refer to it by component ID.

granularity.description: file lists files only. file_and_hunk also lists line ranges.

max_improvement_notes.description: Largest number of improvement notes in the change_shape section. 0 turns the notes off.

location.description: Parent directory for the report directory. The skill never writes the report to a repository.
